benchmark: LookBench v3 (13 Apr 2026); live benchmark - record the access date
source: Gao et al., LookBench, arXiv:2601.14706, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.14706 (latest version at access), Table 3 (Fine-Recall@1). Accessed 2026-11-23 13:00 GMT; transcribed by the owner from the PDF.
metric: Fine-grained Recall@1, 'Overall' column (query-count-weighted over the four LookBench subsets), LookBench v3 Table 3
instructions: Fill 'score' only from the LookBench v3 paper/leaderboard, set 'exact_match' true only when LookBench evaluated the identical checkpoint/resolution/embedding (state why in 'match_basis'), else false. Models with score null or exact_match not true are listed but excluded from the correlation (repbench.v2.sensitivities.run_lookbench).
notes: HANDOFF_V2 6.9 states Marqo-FashionCLIP = 63.24 in LookBench v3; verify against the paper before entering it.
v1 (scripts/analyze_benchmark.py) used an earlier LookBench version; its numbers are not v3 and are not reused here.
